name: DS Cluster S24: Futures Continuation (All 7 Inputs Required)
description: Tests: futures_continuation with all 7 OHLCV+OI+Symbol inputs, LiquidityBased rollover, NoAdjustment. Outputs: .c, .carry, .spread, .dte. Pass-through on stocks.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S24: Futures Continuation — All 7 Inputs Required
# =============================================================================
# S24 rule: futures_continuation requires ALL 7 inputs: o, h, l, c, v, oi, s
# Empty inputs → "missing input(o)" compile error.

src = market_data_source()()

# === DEFAULT: LiquidityBased + NoAdjustment ===
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    i_offset=0
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
carry = cont.carry
dte = cont.dte
spread = cont.spread
oi = cont.oi

# === SMA on continuation output (NOT on raw src) ===
ma_20 = sma(close, 20)
ma_50 = sma(close, 50)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='ES Continuation Close + MAs',
    category='Continuation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.White),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 20', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 50', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, ma_20, ma_50))

xy_lines(
    title='Calendar Carry (Front - Back)',
    category='Continuation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry', color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero')])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=carry)

xy_lines(
    title='Days to Expiry',
    category='Continuation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='DTE', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=dte)

xy_lines(
    title='Open Interest',
    category='Continuation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='OI', color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=oi)
